vocab.Desgaste metálico acumulado del co: Accumulated metal wear of the component over its current life
vocab.Desgaste por partículas abrasivas: Wear caused by abrasive particles in the engine
vocab.Desgaste progresivo de cojinetes d: Progressive wear of connecting-rod and main bearings
vocab.Diferencia térmica persistente ent: Persistent thermal difference between the banks of the V16 engine
vocab.Falla en el sistema de turbocompre: Failure in the two-stage turbocharging system, with loss of boost and efficiency
vocab.Fuga de gases de combustión al cár: Leakage of combustion gases into the crankcase
vocab.Ingreso de contaminantes externos: Ingress of external contaminants into the system
vocab.Ingreso de partículas contaminante: Ingress of contaminant particles that cause accelerated wear on internal metal surfaces
vocab.Ingreso de refrigerante al aceite: Coolant entering the oil due to gasket, liner O-ring or crack failures
vocab.Lubricación insuficiente que gener: Insufficient lubrication causing metal-to-metal contact and accelerated wear
vocab.Pérdida progresiva de propiedades: Progressive loss of lubricating properties due to contamination and thermal stress
vocab.Se analiza Hierro, Silicio y Cobre: Iron, Silicon and Copper from gear wear are analyzed, correlated with gear mismatches and transmission slip.
vocab.Se analiza el Hollín y la dilución: Soot and Fuel dilution in the oil are analyzed, together with the average exhaust gas temperature and the fuel delivery pressure. Elevated soot with hot exhaust indicates poor combustion; dilution with low fuel pressure suggests a leaking injector. Note: the current source does not expose injector metering pressure, commanded rail pressure or the water-in-fuel indicator, so injection fault detection relies mostly on oil analysis.
vocab.Se analiza el desgaste del convert: Torque converter wear is analyzed through Aluminum, Copper and Iron, correlated with lock-up slip and converter outlet temperature.
vocab.Se analiza la calidad de combustió: Combustion quality is analyzed through the oil's Soot and Viscosity, together with the exhaust temperatures (left, right and differential). Elevated soot with viscosity changes and anomalous temperatures indicates poor combustion.
vocab.Se correlaciona la Presión del Cár: Crankcase Pressure (CnkcasePres) is correlated with the Soot content in the oil. Elevated crankcase pressure accompanied by high soot indicates combustion gas leakage into the crankcase (blow-by).
vocab.Se correlaciona la presión del cár: Crankcase pressure is correlated with the Soot and Chromium content in the oil, together with the reserve tank level. Elevated crankcase pressure with high soot indicates combustion gas leakage (blow-by); rising Chromium confirms ring wear.
vocab.Se correlacionan los metales de co: Bearing metals (Lead, Copper) are correlated with the engine Oil Pressure. Elevated metals combined with low pressure are indicators of lubrication system failure.
Bearing metals (Lead, Copper) are correlated with the lubrication system pressures (rifle and oil differential). High metals with low pressure indicate lubrication failure.
vocab.Se evalúa Sodio y Potasio en aceit: Sodium and Potassium in the oil are evaluated together with the coolant temperature and pressure. Their presence indicates coolant entering the oil circuit.
vocab.Se evalúa el desgaste de los disco: Clutch disc wear is evaluated through Iron, Copper and Aluminum in the oil, correlated with lock-up and transmission slip. Elevated metals with abnormal slip indicate clutch pack wear.
vocab.Se evalúa el desgaste metálico acu: The component's accumulated metal wear since its last change (Iron, Copper, Lead, Chromium, Aluminum and Tin) is evaluated from the totals accumulated per engine life cycle.
vocab.Se evalúa el ingreso de contaminan: Ingress of external contaminants into the system is evaluated through Silicon, Water, Sodium and Potassium. These elements are not generated by internal wear and their presence indicates contamination of the hydraulic circuit.
vocab.Se evalúa la calidad de los cambio: Gear shift quality is evaluated through Viscosity and Iron in the oil, correlated with slip, gear mismatches and lock-up.
vocab.Se evalúa la concentración de part: The concentration of metal particles (Iron, Aluminum) and abrasive contaminants (Silicon) in the oil is evaluated. Sustained increases suggest internal wear or ingress of external contaminants.

The concentration of metal particles (Iron, Chromium) and abrasive contaminants (Silicon) in the oil is evaluated. Increases in Iron and Chromium suggest internal component wear, while elevated Silicon indicates ingress of external contaminants.
vocab.Se evalúa la condición del aceite: The oil's condition is evaluated through its Viscosity and Soot content. Changes outside the expected ranges indicate accelerated degradation, compromising the engine's lubrication and protection capability.
The oil's condition is evaluated through Soot and Oxidation, correlated with the oil temperature. Out-of-range changes indicate accelerated degradation of the lubricant.
vocab.Se monitorea Plomo y Cobre (materi: Lead and Copper (bearing materials) are monitored together with Oil Pressure. A sustained increase in these metals indicates progressive wear of the engine bearings.
vocab.Se monitorea Plomo, Cobre y Estaño: Lead, Copper and Tin (bearing materials) are monitored together with the rifle oil pressure. Sustained increases indicate progressive bearing wear.
vocab.Se monitorea el diferencial entre: The differential between the exhaust temperatures of the left and right banks is monitored. A sustained delta may indicate injection, turbo or cylinder distribution problems.
The differential between the left and right exhaust temperatures is monitored. A high or sustained delta may indicate problems in injectors, valves, turbo or air distribution between cylinders.
vocab.Se monitorea la degradación del ac: Oil degradation from excessive temperature is monitored, evaluating Viscosity and Water together with converter outlet and transmission oil temperatures.
vocab.Se monitorea la velocidad del turb: Turbo speed and intake pressures per bank are monitored. Sustained deviations may indicate deterioration or failure of the turbocharger.
vocab.Se monitorean Hierro, Cobre, Plomo: Iron, Copper, Lead and Tin (bearing materials) are monitored together with the transmission oil temperature. Sustained increases suggest progressive bearing wear.
